### PSQ Holdings Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results Release Date & Conference Call


November 5, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s203.q4cdn.com/702081897/files/doc_news/PSQ-Holdings-Announces-Third-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results-Release-Date--Conference-Call-2026.pdf)


BOZEMAN, Mont.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


PSQ Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: PSQH) (the "Company") today announced it will host a teleconference and webcast to discuss its third quarter 2026 results beginning at 9:00 a.m. EST on Friday, November 6, 2026. The Company will issue a news release on November 6, 2026, before the U.S. stock market opens, containing third quarter 2026 results.


The conference call can be accessed live through a link on the PSQ Holdings Investor Relations website at[investors.publicsquare.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Finvestors.publicsquare.com&esheet=54636070&newsitemid=20261105228568&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.publicsquare.com&index=1&md5=674fe7bd00e6406365fe4fe9a0ca9c89) . During the webcast, the Company will take both inbound questions received ahead of the call and questions from equity research analysts. Additionally, you can participate in the conference call by dialing (833) 461-5787 domestically or (585) 542-9983 internationally, and referencing meeting ID #689559803. Attendees should log in to the webcast or dial in approximately 15 minutes before the start time of the call.


**About PSQ Holdings, Inc.**


PSQ Holdings (NYSE: PSQH) is a payments and financial infrastructure company. We build and operate financial infrastructure in highly regulated environments for industries underserved by traditional financial institutions, including businesses, campaigns, and nonprofits that depend on reliable, compliant payment solutions.
